newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish telecoms net drops to PLN 850 mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Polish telecoms net drops to PLN 850 mln in 1996.

text.p: The net profit of Polish telecommunications monopoly Telekomunikacja Polska SA (TPSA) fell in 1996 to 850 million zlotys from 933 million in 1995, TPSA said in a statement on Monday.
Revenues rose to 6.65 billion zlotys from 5.4 billion in 1995, as the number of telephones rose in 1996 by 810,084 to 6,538,581, or 16.94 per 100 Poles from 14.85 in 1995.
TPSA said its total costs in 1996 were 5.03 billion zlotys, but no comparable figures for 1995 were immediately available.
TPSA said the number of telephones rose to 6,608,012 on February 15, taking the ratio per 100 inhabitants to 17.12.
